title: Console installation manifest
responsibility: Reads and writes the host’s console installation record, retaining file ownership and change history.

inputs.name: writeConsoleManifest.host
inputs.description: Host project directory in which harness.console.json will be written.

inputs.name: writeConsoleManifest.manifest
inputs.description: Installation record to serialize, including file entries, ownership and changes. The files array is sorted on a copy before writing.

outputs.name: consoleManifest
outputs.description: Parsed installation record with schemaVersion forced to 1, missing files and changes defaulted to empty arrays, and missing file ownership defaulted to harness. Read failures return an empty record; malformed JSON still rejects.

outputs.name: writeConsoleManifest
outputs.description: Resolves after writing tab-indented JSON with a trailing newline and files sorted by path. The target file is replaced; write failures reject.
